# F-star residue class (ii): non-3-dichromatic zero digraphs - the matched-pivot floor, the fixtures' dichromatic structure, and a smallest-first falsifier search (no kappa)

## Scope

Kappa-blocker **KB5c** (explicit open request; scope changed from the drawn card and recorded in `TASK.json`): residue class **(ii) non-3-dichromatic zero digraphs** of open problem **F-star** of the merged `research/root-unit-decoder-lemmas` package ([PR 1590](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1590) by DreamingOfClouds, with Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic) via Claude Code assistance; section 7): `cert(M) >= floor(2v/3)` for every exact 3-total rational decoder `M = sum_j p_j q_j^T`. This is the residue [PR 2717](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2717) by Aaron Wang (navinor) demoted as "zero digraphs that are not 3-dichromatic (Lemma MP then gives only `sum_i MAS(Z[C_i])`)" and left untouched by [PR 2747](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2747) by Aaron Wang (navinor), which closed residue class (i). Package `research/fstar-zero-digraph-residue-seede9937f18/`, registered replay `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=completed` on CPython 3.12.

The package does three things: (1) exact zero-digraph machinery (MAS over all subsets by DP, the exact Lemma MP value `max_c sum_i MAS(Z[C_i])` over all pivot maps `c : [v] -> D(t)`, dichromatic numbers of `Z` with and without the pivot constraint sets `D(t)`); (2) calibration on DreamingOfClouds' stored fixtures `tied_min` (12 lines) and `cex_min_1` (19 lines) reproducing every recorded anchor, then the exact dichromatic structure of both zero digraphs (the open question 2 of PR 2717); (3) a smallest-first adversarial search for the first instance where the matched-pivot value falls below `floor(2v/3)` (the open question 1 of PR 2747, which is exactly this class's floor question). **F-star itself is not proved and not refuted here.** Every claim is labelled PROVEN, CHECKED or DEMOTED.

## New: the dichromatic structure of the canonical fixtures - CHECKED

| instance | v | `floor(2v/3)` | `chi(Z)` unconstrained | `MAS(Z)` | largest mutual-zero clique | MP (exhaustive) | `v - MP` | 3-dichromatic under `D` |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tied_min` | 12 | 8 | 3 exactly (subset DP, exhaustive) | 4 | 3 | 9 | 3 | no |
| `cex_min_1` | 19 | 12 | 3 exactly (colouring found; a mutual-zero triangle forces 3) | 10 | 3 | 16 | 3 | no |

Consequences, each CHECKED:

1. Both canonical fixtures have dichromatic number exactly 3 without the pivot constraints. The obstruction that keeps `cert(M)` below `v` on `cex_min_1` (18 of 19) is therefore not the dichromatic number of the digraph; it lives in the pivot constraint sets `D(t)` together with the labelling structure. PR 2717's open question 2 ("can `Z` itself be non-3-dichromatic") is not realized by either fixture; both fixtures are non-3-dichromatic under `D`, which is the operative sense of class (ii) for Lemma MP.
2. The largest mutual-zero clique is 3 on both fixtures: the Lemma RK (a) bound (no mutual-zero `K_4`) is attained, so clique bounds alone cannot force a dichromatic number above 3 on these instances.
3. The matched-pivot value loses exactly 3 lines on each fixture (9 below 12, 16 below 19), and both values stay at or above both threshold forms (9 versus 8; 16 versus 12 and 13). F-star holds on both canonical class-(ii) instances by the structural certificate alone.

## New: smallest-first falsifier search in the class-(ii) domain - CHECKED (scoped negative)

Smallest falsifying instance first: `v` ascending from 3, four generator families per `v` (entries in `{-1,0,1}` and `{-2..2}`), all aimed at the residue: `random` / `random2` (unstructured boxes), `sparse` (1-2 nonzero coordinates per `p(t)`, `q(t)`, dense zero digraphs), `forced` (support masks chosen first so at least half the lines have `|D(t)| = 1`, heavily constrained pivot maps), `mutual` (rejection sampling for many mutual-zero pairs). 286 instances, `v = 3..12`, deterministic seeds per instance in `CERTIFICATE.json`.

| quantity | value |
|---|---|
| falsifiers (explicit admissible `B` with chain cost below `floor(2v/3)`, or exact `cert` below threshold) | 0 |
| instances with matched-pivot value below `floor(2v/3)` | 0 |
| minimum matched-pivot ratio | 2/3 (attained at `v = 3`, seed 4611, matched-pivot value 2 equal to `floor(2v/3)`) |
| minimum engine-witness ratio | 0.909 (10 at `v = 11`; every witness above threshold) |
| instances non-3-dichromatic under `D` (matched-pivot value below `v`) | 8 (listed below) |
| instances with `chi(Z) >= 4` unconstrained | 0 found (286 of 286 backtracking decisions found a 3-colouring; 0 undecided) |

The complete class-(ii) population found (every one has `chi(Z)` at most 3 unconstrained and `cert(M) = v` exactly by exhaustive a-enumeration):

| v | seed | family | MP | `floor(2v/3)` | exact `cert` | arcs in `Z` | mutual-zero pairs |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | 4611 | random | 2 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 1 |
| 4 | 4641 | random | 3 | 2 | 4 | 4 | 1 |
| 4 | 4932 | random | 3 | 2 | 4 | 3 | 1 |
| 6 | 6788 | random2 | 5 | 4 | 6 | 5 | 1 |
| 8 | 8848 | sparse | 7 | 5 | 8 | 22 | 5 |
| 9 | 9654 | sparse | 8 | 6 | 9 | 25 | 5 |
| 10 | 10932 | random | 9 | 6 | 10 | 26 | 3 |
| 10 | 10654 | sparse | 9 | 6 | 10 | 33 | 7 |

**Exact obstruction record (early kill).** The matched-pivot value never fell below `floor(2v/3)` anywhere in the domain; its deficit `v - MP` never exceeded 3 (attained only on the fixtures), while the MP route would need the deficit to exceed `ceil(v/3)` (4 at `v = 12`, 7 at `v = 19`) to fail on an instance. The first instance where the matched-pivot value touches the floor exactly (`v = 3`, seed 4611) still has `cert(M) = v` exactly. On all eight class-(ii) instances the general labellings reach `cert(M) = v` while matched pivots do not: label patterns beyond matched pivots (the same effect PR 2747 documented on `tied_min`, matched-pivot 9 versus `cert` 11) carry the certificate there.

## What is proved, what is witnessed, what is demoted

- **PROVEN:** nothing new. This package proves no new lemma; Lemma MP and the chain `cost >= sum_j r_j >= cert(M)` are cited from [PR 2717](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2717) by Aaron Wang (navinor) and the merged `research/root-unit-decoder-lemmas` package ([PR 1590](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1590) by DreamingOfClouds, with Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic) via Claude Code assistance), not restated.
- **CHECKED (machine, `verify.py`, stdlib, deterministic, about 57 s):** controls (brute-force-over-all-labellings agreement 3/3 at `v = 3`, diagonal decoder `cert = 3`, corrupted-witness rejection 2/2, subset-DP MAS hand values 3/3, dichromatic hand values 4/4, MP 3 on the diagonal decoder); the calibration table above; the dichromatic structure of both fixtures; and the 286-instance search with exact MP values, replayed witnesses, exact `cert` where a-enumeration terminates, and bounded admissible-`B` chain scans.
- **DEMOTED / OPEN:** F-star for general rational decoders is neither proved nor refuted. The matched-pivot floor `max_c sum_i MAS(Z[C_i]) >= floor(2v/3)` is witnessed on 288 instances (2 fixtures plus 286 searched), not proved. No "exactly when" or necessity claim is made for any hypothesis. Whether some rank-3 zero digraph has `chi(Z) >= 4` unconstrained remains open (none found here; the decision is exact when it terminates and no run in this domain was undecided, but the search is bounded in `v`). Chain costs are bounded-search upper bounds on the minimum, not exact minima. The recorded fixture limits 11 and 18 rest on PR 2111's recorded CP-SAT optimality, not re-verified here. Residue classes (i) and (iii) are not re-attacked. One control's expected value was initially written wrong (the dichromatic number of a directed 3-cycle is 2, not 1; the subset DP returned the correct 2) and the control was corrected after the first run; the correction is recorded in the README rather than hidden.

## Reproduce

Python 3.10+, standard library only, from the repository root:

```sh
python3 -B research/fstar-zero-digraph-residue-seede9937f18/verify.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/fstar-zero-digraph-residue-seede9937f18 --check-only
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/fstar-zero-digraph-residue-seede9937f18
```

Expected markers: `PASS_FZD_CONTROLS`, `PASS_FZD_FIXTURES`, `PASS_FZD_SEARCH`, `PASS_FSTAR_ZERO_DIGRAPHS`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/fstar-zero-digraph-residue-seede9937f18 outcome=completed`, and `CERTIFICATE.json` with digest `86f48c1bacdbe4a9`. `make` is not installed on the authoring host; the commands above are the underlying ones.
